newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian June wage inflation 4.6 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italian June wage inflation 4.6 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian wage inflation stood at an annual 4.6 percent in June, statistics institute ISTAT said in a statement.
ITALY HOURLY WAGE INFLATION June 97 May 97 June 96

Istat said wage inflation in the agriculture sector rose 2.3 percent year-on-year in June, 3.8 percent in the industrial sector, 2.5 percent in the chemical sector, 4.6 percent in the metalworkers sector, 3.3 percent in the service sector, 1.8 percent in the transport and communications sector and 7.2 percent in the public administration.
The statistics office added that the number of hours lost to industrial action in the first five months was a provisional 5.55 million hours from 1.99 million in the same 1996 period.
